There is only one visible person; the companion is off camera.

Preserve Image 1's EXACT complete close-camera room: full wooden window and clear autumn lake-town view, curtains, LEFT writing desk and original wooden chair, shelves/books/frames/plants, the ROUND table with blue-white porcelain lamp/cup/flowers/books, long linen window bench, right blue-gray plaid pillows and knitted throw, wood floor/rug/foreground plant. The round table stays approximately x435–690 with its top near y500; the left desk ends around x400 with its top near y380. Do not enlarge the desk, move the chair/table, change the window, change camera/perspective, crop or redesign furniture. This pose uses the existing BENCH, so there is no need to alter the desk at all.

Anon Chihaya / 千早愛音, BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!. Faithful youthful anime identity as in her correct approved second input: long clear PINK hair, natural side-swept bangs, large clear BLUE-GRAY eyes and a fine lively youthful face. BOTH eyes and bangs remain clear. Her Haneoka uniform remains a pale lavender-gray blazer with white piping/two small gold buttons, white shirt, dark green necktie, dark green/gold plaid skirt, dark knee socks and BLACK loafers. Ordinary youthful student proportions, fully clothed; no borrowed face, chibi or mature model body, no recoloring her whole body gold.

Basic supported planning pose: sit on the actual open section of the window BENCH, pelvis and thighs settled with weight on its linen cushion, upper body balanced and gently angled toward the off-camera companion. Hold a SMALL plain notebook low over the lap, one hand naturally steadying it, the other holding a simple pencil lightly paused above an empty corner of the page. The lap supports the notebook; hands and wrists connect clearly to her own arms. Only faint abstract pencil traces, no readable calendar, dates, names, schedule, quotes or completed-arrangement text. Keep the pose simple, fresh and naturally supported, with her complete face visible above the small notebook. Comfortable separately readable knees and lower legs, each belonging to its own continuous hip/thigh/ankle chain. Both complete black loafers rest naturally on the visible real floor with subtle local contacts. Avoid one knee crossing over the other while two parallel feet pretend to be flat. No floating stool, extra limb, hand through book, furniture penetration or invented limb hidden under a blanket.

Match the approved close-room human scale, head top roughly y110–140 and shoe soles naturally around y850–900 according to the actual bench depth. Do not enlarge her head, lean her face toward the camera, stretch shins or move furniture to force a coordinate. Keep all hair, both hands, skirt/knees/ankles and BOTH complete shoes in the frame with breathing room. Almond-gold clear-day light touches pink hair tips, paper and hands, with a clear gentle facial shadow side. Preserve the same original room light and natural local colors. Refined 2D anime linework and soft anime shading integrated with the literary-room illustration, no sticker border, gray/gold overlay, new spotlight, UI, logo, watermark, captions, collage or fog.
